title: Compatibility of cyclic coefficient pullback comparisons
statement: theorem cyclicCoefficientPullbackCompatibility {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ X) (e q : ℕ) (W V : X.Etale) (v : V ⟶ W) (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst h W.hom)).obj (Y.constantZMod e)) q) : let g := pullback.map h V.hom h W.hom (𝟙 Y) v.left (𝟙 X) (by simp) (by simp) let i := upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g (pullback.fst h W.hom) (pullback.fst h V.hom) (by simp [g]) Sheaf.H.map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift (ZMod e)))).hom q (cohomologyMap g _ q (Sheaf.H.map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst h W.hom)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift (ZMod e)))).hom q x)) = Sheaf.H.map ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst h V.hom)).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift (ZMod e)))).hom q (Sheaf.H.map (i.inv.app (Y.constantZMod e)) q (cohomologyMap g _ q x))

proof.text: The base-change map g satisfies g followed by the first projection for W equals the first projection for V, by pullback.map_fst and the identity laws. Generalize the named composite k and its equality proof, then substitute k, to apply constantPullbackCompositionCoherence without a dependent rewrite of upperStarComp.

Apply Iso.ext to the resulting equality of homs of composed isomorphisms and apply congrArg Iso.inv. This gives upperStar(g).map(cf.hom) followed by cg.hom equals the inverse upperStarComp component followed by cv.hom.

Use cohomologyMap_map, the already proved coefficient naturality law in the module of def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback, to commute H.map(cf.hom) past cohomologyMap g. Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply combines the two coefficient maps. Substitute the coefficient morphism equality and use Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply again to obtain the stated equality.

proof_origin.place: Constant coefficient comparison, followed by naturality in coefficients and functoriality of Sheaf.H.map
